newsitem.title: UK: Next doesn't plan pre-Christmas markdowns.
newsitem.headline: Next doesn't plan pre-Christmas markdowns.

text.p: British clothing retailer Next Plc has no intention of setting last minute price cuts to bolster Christmas sales, chief executive David Jones said on Tuesday.

Market talk that the retailer would cut prices ahead of Christmas to make up for soft sales in recent weeks is "utterly untrue", Jones told Reuters. Merchandise will be marked down after Christmas, as usual, he added.
Shares in Next sank to a five-week low earlier amid worries sales were not as strong as many had anticipated.
Asked to comment, Jones said: "The share price moves up and down and that's not a concern. What's important is that our tills are ringing and they have been ringing quite nicely."
Next will report Christmas figures during the first or second week of January, he said.
